clue.text: Second time son lags freezing tubes

indicators.note: to lag is to trail behind, so this piece comes after the one before it

parts.note: freezing weather is raw, bitterly cold
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: For the second time a boy is slow to insulate pipes against the frost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lags' looks like pipe insulation in a scene about freezing tubes, but here it means trails behind: the son's S follows RAW.
explanation.definitionFit: Drinking straws are thin hollow cylinders, so they are tubes.

clue.text: Roll I start to prepare for veggie

parts.note: to roll over is to turn

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, taken from the following word

explanation.surface: A cook rolls something before starting to get a vegetable ready.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnip is a root vegetable, and veggie is informal for a vegetable.

clue.text: Hostess in boob tube? I say!

definitions.text: Hostess in boob tube? I say!

parts.words: Hostess in boob tube? I say!
parts.note: a woman presenting on the television, the boob tube, whose whole job is to declare things to viewers

explanation.surface: A shocked exclamation at a hostess wearing a strapless top.
explanation.walkthrough: A boob tube is a strapless top in Britain, but also slang for television: the hostess is on screen, introducing programmes.
explanation.definitionFit: A television presenter who introduces programmes and reads news is a broadcaster of this kind.

clue.text: Peter laid out tent around the end of May as a precaution

parts.note: peter is old criminal slang for a safe

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit around the next piece
something laid out is spread and arranged anew, so these letters are rearranged
the end of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A man called Peter pitches his tent near the end of May just in case.
explanation.walkthrough: Peter looks like a man's name, but it is old criminal slang for a safe; 'laid out' signals the anagram and 'around' the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A safety net is a backup measure taken in case things go wrong, so it is a precaution.

clue.text: Drains stout endlessly assume

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Drains stout endlessly assume': FAT + IGUES needs 'I guess' less its end, but no clue word gives the I; a word (probably 'I') looks lost from the clue as held, and no source found the original

clue.text: Baffle old leftwinger with dance

parts.note: to fox someone is to baffle them
a Trot is a Trotskyist, a dated term for a far-left militant

explanation.surface: An ageing socialist confuses people with his dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: The foxtrot is a ballroom dance.

clue.text: Native lifted by good old dance

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifted means read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: Nat. is an abbreviation for native

explanation.surface: A local person is uplifted by a fine traditional dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The tango is a ballroom dance from Argentina.

clue.text: Ray left with adult in jet, possibly

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Ray left with adult in jet, possibly': L and A put in GEM (jet, possibly) give GLAEM or GELAM, not GLEAM; the only parse that works is an indirect anagram of the synonym GEM, so the clue as held looks wrong for its answer
annotationWithheld.clue: Ray left with adult in jet, possibly

clue.text: I once let lunatic vote

indicators.note: lunatic means crazy, so these letters go wild into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone confesses they once allowed a madman to vote.
explanation.definitionFit: An election is a vote held to choose someone for office.

clue.text: Entrance through firm

parts.note: trans- is a prefix meaning across or through
to fix something is to make it firm

explanation.surface: The way in passes through a company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Entrance' looks like a noun, a doorway, but it is the verb meaning to enchant.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance someone is to hold them spellbound, to rivet their attention.

clue.text: One entering sorry scene finds relatives

indicators.note: one piece goes into the other
sorry here means in a sorry state, so the letters are messed up

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone walking into a miserable scene discovers family members.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sorry' rearranges SCENE into NECES, and 'entering' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Nieces are the daughters of one's siblings, so they are family members.

clue.text: Note dancing tune?

parts.note: mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: letters dancing move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A musical note, then a tune for people to dance to.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a minuet is a dance tune, and the question mark flags the double reading.
explanation.definitionFit: A minuet is a slow stately dance in triple time, and also music written for it.

clue.text: One sharing rings married maiden in respect

indicators.note: the first pieces go inside the word for respect

parts.note: to rate someone is to respect them
O is ring-shaped, so two rings give OO
M is the cricket abbreviation for maiden, an over with no runs

explanation.surface: A wedded young woman shares a set of rings, out of regard for someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A roommate is a person who shares a room or flat with another.

clue.text: Mother caught by waterproof

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Mum is caught in her raincoat.
explanation.walkthrough: MAC is short for mackintosh, a British word for a raincoat.
explanation.definitionFit: A mac is a raincoat, a garment that keeps the rain out.

clue.text: Prisoner's vehicle almost smashing into building

parts.note: con is short for convict, and the possessive gives an S

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a truck is a vehicle

indicators.note: smashing breaks the letters up into a new order

explanation.surface: A convict's lorry nearly crashes into a building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the K of TRUCK; 'smashing' rearranges INTO into TION.
explanation.definitionFit: Construction is the act of building, or a structure that has been built.

clue.text: Banal tour spoiled eastern city

indicators.note: something spoiled is wrecked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dull tour of an eastern city was ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: Ulan Bator is the capital of Mongolia, a city in East Asia.

clue.text: One will get into mashed tattie with interest

indicators.note: these pieces get into the middle of the rearranged letters
mashed potato is crushed, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
'll is the shortened form of will

explanation.surface: Someone adds extra to a plate of mashed potato with keen interest.
explanation.walkthrough: Tattie is Scottish for potato, which makes 'mashed' an apt anagram signal; 'get into' marks the container, and 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To titillate is to excite or arouse, to stir someone's interest.

clue.text: Strangely a rep's had meal alone

indicators.note: strangely means oddly, so these letters change their order

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative, and the possessive gives an S
to have had a meal is to have eaten

explanation.surface: Oddly, a salesman ate his dinner by himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Separate means apart, as being alone is apart from others.

clue.text: Intimate Erato, her that confused

indicators.note: confused means muddled, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Erato, the muse of love poetry, is bewildered by a close woman.
explanation.walkthrough: Erato is the Greek muse of love poetry, apt for an intimate talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A frank, close conversation between two people is called intimate.

clue.text: An expression of gratitude involving European char

indicators.note: involving means enclosing, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: ta is a British informal thank-you

explanation.surface: A thank-you to a European for burning something.
explanation.walkthrough: Char is British slang for tea, from the Chinese cha; 'char' looks like burning.
explanation.definitionFit: Char is a British slang word for the hot drink brewed from leaves.

clue.text: That bloke would embrace love on private dance

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: he'd is the contraction of he would
O is love, a zero score in tennis
one's own is private, belonging to oneself

explanation.surface: A man would hug his love at a dance of their own.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoedown is a lively American folk dance or a party for one.

clue.text: Sibyl's heading away from boat

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', so the definition is Sibyl

indicators.note: the word's heading, its first letter, is removed

parts.note: a coracle is a small round wicker boat

explanation.surface: A woman called Sibyl sets off away from her boat.
explanation.walkthrough: Sibyl looks like a name, but a sibyl is a prophetess in ancient myth.
explanation.definitionFit: An oracle in ancient Greece was a prophet through whom gods spoke, like the sibyls.

clue.text: Crusty lodger? Balance is altered with resistance

indicators.note: altered means changed, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: Someone's bank balance changes because of opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: A barnacle lodges on rocks and hulls inside a crusty shell, so it is a crusty lodger.
explanation.definitionFit: Barnacles are shelled crustaceans that fix themselves for life on rocks, hulls and other surfaces.

clue.text: Almost time for darkness

parts.note: nigh means nearly, almost

explanation.surface: It is nearly time for the dark.
explanation.definitionFit: Night is the time of darkness between dusk and dawn.

clue.text: Dance clubs dealing with grand area

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games
on means about, dealing with a subject
G is slang shorthand for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: Nightclubs handle a great area for dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: The conga is a Latin American dance done in a long line.

clue.text: Run round bottom of tree before dance

indicators.note: this piece comes before the other pieces

parts.note: the bole is the trunk of a tree, its lower part
R is the cricket abbreviation for run
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Someone runs around the foot of a tree before dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: The bolero is a Spanish dance in triple time.

clue.text: Judge old boat with new professional words

parts.note: the Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek myth

explanation.surface: A judge with an old boat and some new specialist terms.
explanation.definitionFit: Jargon is the specialist vocabulary used within a trade or profession.

clue.text: Open marriage? Be superior

parts.note: out means open, revealed, as of a secret
a match is a marriage, a union

explanation.surface: An open marriage raises the question of who is the better partner.
explanation.definitionFit: To outmatch someone is to surpass them, to be better than them.

clue.text: Check shower after a break

indicators.note: this piece follows the one before it

parts.note: a rest is a break
a shower is a fall of rain

explanation.surface: Look at the shower after taking a breather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Check' looks like inspect, but here means hold back.
explanation.definitionFit: To restrain is to hold back or curb, as to check something is.

clue.text: Fly on cut grass whiffed

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after
cut means shortened, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass
a ked is a sheep ked, a wingless louse fly

explanation.surface: An insect lands on freshly mown grass that smelled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' drops the D of REED, giving REE; the sheep ked is a little-known parasitic fly.
explanation.definitionFit: Whiffed is British slang for smelled bad, as did something that stank.
